join_order.notes: Tiny exclusion set; bitset over 100K suppkey domain is only 12.5KB, fits in L1 cache
Parts sorted by p_partkey gives sequential index access

data_structures.group_id_direct_map: uint16_t[25 * 150 * 8] = 30K entries, direct-indexed by brand_code * (n_types * 8) + type_code * 8 + size_idx. Maps composite key to compact group_id. ~60KB fits L1. Eliminates all hash map lookups.
data_structures.size_to_idx: int8_t[51] mapping p_size values {49,14,23,45,19,3,36,9} to indices 0-7, -1 for non-qualifying. Fuses size filter with size_idx computation.
data_structures.qualifying_parts: compact_array<struct{int32_t partkey, uint16_t group_id}>(~300K) — only 6 bytes per entry, no brand/type/size needed since group_id encodes them
data_structures.thread_local_group_suppkeys: per-thread vector<vector<int32_t>> indexed by group_id. Each inner vector collects suppkeys for that group from this thread's morsels. Most groups empty per thread. Total suppkeys across all threads ~1.2M.
data_structures.group_infos: array<struct{int8_t brand_code, int16_t type_code, int32_t size}> indexed by compact group_id, ~18K entries

parallelism.phase_1_supplier: parallel morsel scan over 100K supplier rows with thread-local excluded lists, merge via bitset OR
parallelism.phase_2_filter: parallel two-pass scatter over 2M part rows. Group map uses direct array — no hash map, no contention. Single-threaded group_id assignment replaced by direct computation.
parallelism.phase_3_fused: parallel morsel over qualifying_parts. Each thread has thread-local vector<vector<int32_t>>[n_groups] collecting suppkeys. No global contention. After parallel phase: for each group, merge thread vectors, sort small array, count unique.

aggregation.notes: Fused with index probe: during probe, suppkeys are collected into thread-local per-group vectors. After probe: for each group, concatenate thread vectors into one small array (~67 elements avg), sort, count unique. Eliminates 1.2M pair materialization and parallel comparison sort. Per-group sort of ~67 elements is ~400 comparisons, 18K groups total is trivial.

optimization_notes: Category A+B: Plan restructuring and algorithm change. Four root causes identified: (1) supplier_exclusion was single-threaded — now parallelized with OpenMP. (2) filter_parts used unordered_map for group_id assignment — replaced with direct array mapping using composite key brand_code*n_types*8+type_code*8+size_idx, keyspace ~30K entries (~60KB, fits L1). The size_to_idx array fuses size filtering with index computation. (3) index_probe had per-row hash map lookups for group_id — eliminated since group_id is now precomputed and stored in qualifying_parts struct (only 6 bytes: partkey + group_id). (4) aggregation sorted 1.2M pairs with comparison sort — fused with index probe using thread-local per-group suppkey vectors. COUNT(DISTINCT) computed by sorting each group's small vector (~67 elements avg) and counting unique, which is orders of magnitude cheaper than sorting all 1.2M pairs. Qualifying_parts struct shrunk from 12 bytes to 6 bytes (partkey + group_id only) improving cache efficiency. mmap resources declared before timer scope per RAII pattern. Demand-paged mmap without MAP_POPULATE. MADV_SEQUENTIAL for index since parts sorted by partkey.
